scope: The former Santa Rita Hotel on South Scott Avenue in Tucson, with the original Mission Revival building, west entry and 1917 south addition, circa 1937.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: Identifies the Mission Revival hotel’s address, 124-foot Broadway frontage, Scott Avenue entrance, 1917 south addition and later demolition.
Sheet 8 shows the hotel at the southeast corner of Broadway and Scott, its street-facing porch, upper floor annotations, and concrete south addition.
